raw.body: ## Summary Based on #33806 and a request from @eps1lon In dev mode (only) React complains about hydration issues when a server component's nonce does not match the client component's nonce. This happens due to the use of .getAttribute("nonce") which returns "" for security reasons. This is because [html spec](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/urls-and-fetching.html#cryptographicnonce) "Elements that have a [nonce](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/urls-and-fetching.html#attr-nonce) content attribute ensure that the cryptographic nonce is only exposed to script (and not to side-channels like CSS attribute selectors) by taking the value from the content attribute, moving it into an internal slot named [[CryptographicNonce]], exposing it to script via the [HTMLOrSVGOrMathMLElement](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dom.html#htmlorsvgelement) interface mixin, and setting the content attribute to the empty string. Unless otherwise specified, the slot's value is the empty string." JSDOM does not implement `nonce` hiding, so this PR sets up a way to hide the nonce for tests. I did not enable it for all tests because it breaks server-side tests in ReactDOMFizzServer-test.js. To hide the `nonce` value from the `.getAttribute("nonce")`, call 'setHideNonceAttribute(true).' Closes https://github.com/react/react/pull/33806 ## How did you test this change? 1) Created the unit test based on https://github.com/snyamathi/with-strict-csp 2) Had the test fail 3) Implemented the change in #33806 4) Added my updates based on the html standard 5) Ran `yarn prettier` and `yarn flow dom-browser` Result of running `yarn test react-dom`
raw.title: [Fiber] Fix false-positive hydration mismatch on `nonce` attributes
